compatibility_identity: Ibarz-Tanaka analysis profile of the Shilnikov-Rulkov map

equation_origin.authors: A. L. Shilnikov and N. F. Rulkov
equation_origin.equations: x_next=f_alpha(x,y+beta); y_next=y-mu*(x+1-sigma), with the constant, parabolic, plateau, and fixed -1 reset branches

analysis_profile.authors: B. Ibarz, G. Tanaka, M. A. F. Sanjuan, and K. Aihara

event_convention: one event only when v>0 and the pre-step state executes the fixed -1 fourth branch; an upper guard below v does not override either earlier v<=0 branch
encoding: 1000 row-major pairs of little-endian float64 post-step (v,u), plus 1000 uint8 reset-branch event values
